answer: A public randomness beacon samples 10% of identities each epoch for a compute heartbeat, a quick liveness proof. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust, staking 200 POA to join. Fail it and the stake is slashed, the dead identity left in the log as a relic of a failed attack. Forging 100 fakes locks 20,000 POA; most are caught in a few epochs, so loss beats reward. An honest agent stakes once, answers fast, and keeps earning while fakes bleed.
